## What's Changed
### Security Fixes
* fix(formatter): strip terminal control characters from file paths and messages by @azu in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1735
* fix(gcp): lower PKCS#12 MAC iteration cap and hash with node:crypto by @azu in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1728
### Features
* feat(config-loader): report config problems as warning messages by @azu in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1764
### Bug Fixes
* fix(rules): respect allows option in openai, anthropic, linear, secp256k1-privatekey, and gcp by @azu in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1734
* fix(node): mask secrets by default in createEngine by @azu in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1727
* fix(core): do not throw when rule data contains null by @azu in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1729
* fix(secp256k1-privatekey): detect private keys with a leading zero byte by @azu in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1730
* fix(filter-comments): make bare secretlint-enable close all open disables by @azu in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1731
* fix(formatter): respect --no-terminalLink option by @azu in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1732
* fix(node): exit with 0 when only warning or info messages are found by @azu in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1765
### CI
* Update Patch updates by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1723
* Update github/codeql-action action to v3.38.3 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1726
* Update github/codeql-action action to v3.39.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/secretlint/secretlint/pull/1749
